summary: Comprehensive test of the NEW MerqON Admin Panel (/admin + /api/admin/*) with RBAC, plus member regression. Backend: 47 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_panel.py, ALL PASSED (RBAC, dashboard KPIs, members list/filter/detail/action/note, MLM network+leaderboard+ranks, deposits, withdrawals, income (today/week/month/all + referral top), reconciliation (simulated matched), earnings growth/commission/rewards/autopool, blockchain token/treasury/liquidity (simulated), rules current+versioning (invalid-type 400, version increments and setting update on save), reports deposits/withdrawals/income/members + CSV export + unknown=404, notifications, support tickets (seeded 3) + update, admin users list/create/update-role/delete + protection on root Super Admin (cannot change role or delete), invalid role 400, audit logs populated with suspend/activate/add_note/new_rule_version/update_rewards_config/withdrawal_approve/withdrawal_reject, system get/update, health (mongodb online), emergency: reason required (empty=400), invalid control 400, pause_deposits actually blocks /api/deposit, pause_withdrawals blocks /api/withdraw/request, disable_registration blocks /api/auth/verify for new wallet). Withdrawal workflow verified end-to-end: small <1000 MERQ auto-completes with wallet_balance credit; >1000 creates pending request, admin approve credits member wallet_balance + marks completed, admin reject refunds `available`. All emergency toggles reverted OFF after tests; withdrawal rule reverted to default (auto_approve_under=1000, cooldown=24). Frontend: /admin login flow (Demo Super Admin Wallet -> Sign In to Admin -> /admin/dashboard) worked. Dashboard renders all KPI cards (Members 48/29/19/48, Deposits 65,900, Withdrawals 2,580, Business Volume, Income Distributed MERQ: Referral 3,300 / Growth 0 / Commission 998 / Rewards 150, Autopool stats) + Member Growth area chart + Income Distribution pie chart + Deposit vs Withdrawal bar chart. All 24 admin-nav-* tabs navigate without errors (dashboard, members, network, leaderboard, ranks, deposits, withdrawals, income, reconciliation, growth, commission, rewards, autopool, token, treasury, liquidity, rules, reports, notifications, support, users, audit, health, emergency, settings). Members page shows members-table with 48 rows + 48 member-view-<addr> buttons; clicking opens Member Detail showing Overview/Financial/Network sections. Rules page exposes 5 rule-save-* buttons. Reports has report-export button. Emergency Center shows 5 emergency-toggle-* controls. Audit page shows audit-table rich with recent actions (update_ticket, withdrawal_reject, withdrawal_approve, update_system, delete_admin, update_admin, create_admin, new_rule_version, update_ranks, activate, add_note, suspend). Member regression at / confirmed: nav-admin is NOT present in member sidebar; demo member login still reaches /dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_panel.py: `admins` list exposes admin addresses but when creating a new admin the member record is NOT auto-created — if that admin later tries to call /api/admin/me without having first authenticated as a member via /api/auth/verify, current_member() will raise 404 Member not registered. The new admin must sign in once via the wallet flow before admin endpoints work; this is fine for the demo but should be documented in UI.

admin_panel.py line ~635 create_admin: `existing` is fetched but then only `admin_addresses` set is updated; the `existing` variable is unused — remove dead code or actually seed a member row so the admin can sign in without the one-time nonce flow being blocked.

admin_panel.py: `/api/admin/health` calls https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/ping synchronously with `requests` inside an async handler — blocks event loop for up to 4s. Use httpx.AsyncClient (same issue flagged in iteration_1 for /api/price).

admin_panel.py `/api/admin/system` PUT allowed keys do not include `maintenance_mode` toggle via dedicated audit; it IS in the allowed set but turning maintenance_mode=True does not actually gate any member endpoints (only `paused` and `emergency.*` are checked in server.py deposit/withdraw/autopool paths). Either wire maintenance_mode into gates or remove it from UI to prevent operator confusion.

admin_panel.py `treasury` returns alerts based on `nfo_balance < 1000` where nfo_balance = tvl*0.4 — the threshold is unlikely to trigger in production because tvl*0.4 scales with the system. Threshold should be configurable, not derived.

admin_panel.py `_new_rule_version` doesn't guard against writes when payload would downgrade — any admin can roll back critical settings silently. Consider a confirm/2FA step for referral_pct/withdrawal rule changes.

server.py still has legacy /api/admin/settings and /api/admin/analytics referenced in the OLD test_merqon_api.py but those endpoints were REMOVED when the admin_panel router replaced them — the old test file (iteration 1) will now fail its TestAdmin block if re-run. Not blocking, but recommend deleting the TestAdmin class from /app/backend/tests/test_merqon_api.py or marking it xfail. The new /app/backend/tests/test_admin_panel.py supersedes it.
admin_panel.py uses blocking `requests` import but only inside /health — move the import inside the function or switch to httpx.
admin_panel.py `tickets` seed assigns address=ADMIN_DEMO_ADDRESS to all tickets — in real life tickets originate from different members; fine for demo.
test_credentials: Super Admin seeded: email=admin@merqon.io bound to wallet 0xf39Fd6e51aad88F6F4ce6aB8827279cffFb92266 (pk 0xac0974...ff80), role=SUPER_ADMIN. In UI use admin-connect-demo + admin-sign-button on /admin.

Admin members count now 48; multiple TEST_automated notes attached; a few TEST_ emergency audit entries. All emergency controls returned to OFF after tests. Withdrawal rule reverted to defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin panel API tests in /app/backend/tests/test_admin_panel.py (run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env). All 47 passed. Key admin data-testids verified: admin-connect-demo, admin-sign-button, admin-nav-<24-routes>, members-table, member-view-<addr>, rule-save-<type> (5 buttons), report-export, emergency-toggle-<key> (5 toggles), audit-table. Member nav-admin removed as required. Known limitations: new admins created via POST /api/admin/admins must sign-in once via wallet flow before admin endpoints resolve (because current_member checks members collection, which is populated only on /api/auth/verify). admin_panel.py has blocking `requests.get` in /health.
